id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

jiraKey.description: The key for the ticket that was matched.

jiraSummary.description: The summary of the jira ticket that was matched.

matchedKnownError.description:
The known error that was used to match the jiraIssue. Helpful because there are often multiple known errors per
ticket

knownErrorsSnapshot.description:
Snapshot of Known errors for the jiraIssue. Helpful because it can change over time. This grants us
visibility into the known error at the time of match.

ignoreAll.description: Whether the matched issue had a ignore all flag, which means all other testcases will be suppressed.

issueType.description: Type of issue: Test, Infra-Related, Tracking etc.
